issues.claim: Airdex Inc. (HVAC, town New Brunswick, address Unknown)
issues.problem: No in-zone evidence survives checking. The cited Birdeye page is a city-only stub with no street address and no reviews, and the only street address carried by directories for Airdex Inc. is 385 New Brunswick Ave, Fords, NJ 08863 (Woodbridge Township). Its site airdexinc.com does not load (certificate error).
issues.fix: Drop unless a New Brunswick address or phone is confirmed; otherwise reclassify as an out-of-zone (Fords) firm.

issues.claim: J Angeles Painting & Decoration LLC (website http://jangelespainting.com, town New Brunswick)
issues.problem: The cited website resolves to 'J.A. Painting and Decorations LLC', which advertises service in Monmouth & Ocean counties, not Middlesex/New Brunswick, and publishes no New Brunswick address. The entry's only listed source is a LocationsNear category page, so neither the site nor the zone membership is established.

issues.claim: Kenneth & Sons HVAC, 66 Georges Rd (note says a 'Custom Construction Company' record at the same address was merged into it)
issues.problem: The merge conflates two separate listings. NJ Business Directory lists 'Kenneth & Sons HVAC' at 66 Georges Rd, while all-contractors.com lists 'Custom Construction CO' twice (66 Georges Rd and 118 Sandford St) as a different business. The 118 Sandford St record is missing from the output, and the combined entry is presented as one company.
issues.fix: Split into two entries: Kenneth & Sons HVAC (66 Georges Rd, NJBD) and Custom Construction Co (both all-contractors records).

issues.claim: Ster Plumbing Inc. (town New Brunswick, 24 Birdeye reviews)
issues.problem: Birdeye gives city only, no street address; a contractor database record for the same company shows 21 Hageman Rd, Somerset NJ 08873 and reports the plumbing licence as inactive. In-zone status and current activity are unsupported.
issues.fix: Verify by phone or drop; do not treat as a New Brunswick business until an in-city address or active licence is confirmed.

issues.problem: Rests entirely on one Cylex category page that returns HTTP 403 to this environment. An independent search of New Brunswick plumber directories did not surface the firm at all.
issues.fix: Confirm via a phone number or map listing before outreach, or remove.

issues.claim: Coverage of garage-door, appliance-repair and window/glass trades
issues.problem: The list has no garage-door, appliance-repair or window-installer entries at all, yet in-city businesses exist in all three (Affordable Overhead Doors, 77 Paterson St; Modern Appliance Repair Inc., 600 Jersey Ave; Pramukh Aluminum & Glass at 1130 Somerset St, though that one may have moved to Somerset).
issues.fix: Add at least one entry per missing trade, or record the gaps explicitly in categories_thin.

issues.claim: all-contractors.com New Brunswick list was 'read in full' (37 records, 20 added)
issues.problem: Three in-city records from that same list are not in the output and are not mentioned as excluded: Affordable Properties (100 Jersey Ave), Carista & Remodeling LLC (375 Delavan St) and Benchmark Acoustics (3 Brookside Ave).
issues.fix: Add them as bulk-directory records with the same low-confidence flag, or state why each was dropped.

issues.claim: Treatment of city-name-branded listings (NJ Commercial and Industrial Roofing New Brunswick, Greyson Furnace Repair New Brunswick)
issues.problem: These are city-branded marketing listings (the roofing 'address' also appears on a roofing lead-generation brand site, and a same-named furnace-repair firm operates in Green Bay, WI), yet the mapper excluded comparable city-name brands elsewhere (Sewer-Man, The LockSmith People). The rule is applied inconsistently.
issues.fix: Apply one rule: either keep all city-branded listings with a 'verify before outreach' flag, or drop them all.

issues.problem: The same Yellow Pages pest-control category cited for the entry carries a street address for Arrow (94 Loretto St, New Brunswick) — a small but avoidable gap.
issues.fix: Add the street address (flagged as directory-derived) or note explicitly why it was left blank.
